Name: Workshoppa
Author: Jacob5800
Description: Automates workshop material turn-ins, retainer deposits and voyage collection/redeployment for company airships and submarines, with optional repairs and per-vessel routes.
Changelog:
- Add a Voyages tab for airships and submarines: collect rewards and repeat previous routes, with separate toggles and optional automatic panel-start.
- Add per-vessel inclusion and ordered routes of up to five destinations, plus optional repairs for broken parts.
- Check vessel identity, travelling status, route availability, fuel and range before dispatch; stop and notify when a run cannot continue.
